# Propworm — full site text

> The three pages of https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/propworm-site/ as one Markdown file, for AI assistants and readers. Propworm is a toy-theatre puzzle game for iPhone, coming soon to the App Store (no App Store link yet). © 2026 Luong Nguyen.

---

## Home — https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/propworm-site/

A puzzle game for iPhone.

### Unpin the scenery before the woodworm does.

A paper toy theatre held together with wing nuts. Tap them free, sort them into tins, and watch the woodworm take one step through the set every time you do.

Coming soon on the App Store. Want to know when it launches? Email lamnv260398@gmail.com.

No ads · No tracking · Plays offline

### Every tap moves the worm.

Numbered tape marks show the woodworm's next three steps. If it lands on a free wing nut, it knocks it out, into its tin or onto your bench. If not, it bores a hole in the top flat, and sometimes that hole shows a nut hidden underneath.

So every tap is two moves: yours, and the worm's. Plan around it, or use it.

### How it plays

1. Tap a free wing nut and it flies to the open tin of its colour. Each tin holds three, two tins are open at a time, and you can see the next one.
2. No matching tin? The nut waits on a five-place bench. Fill the bench and the scene ends.
3. When its last nut comes out, a flat falls. Clear the stage and the curtain comes down.
4. 60 scenes in three acts. The first scenes each teach one rule, and How to play is always one tap away.

### Three tools in the wings

- **Top Hat**: one more bench place. It also rescues a full bench.
- **Spanner**: take any nut, even one that is covered.
- **Intermission**: the woodworm rests for five taps.

You start with two of each and earn more on every fifth scene and at the end of each act.

### Fair play

No ads. No tracking. No analytics. No account. It works offline, and your progress stays on your iPhone.

Two optional purchases:

- **Stagehand Kit**, $1.99: five of each tool. Buy it again any time.
- **Spotlight**, $2.99 once: hidden nuts show their colour, and you see six woodworm marks ahead.

Restore Purchases is in Settings.

### Made by hand

Crimson velvet, a warm stone wall, painted plywood flats. Twelve original sounds. VoiceOver reaches every free nut, and Reduce Motion is respected.

### Questions

**Is it free?**
Yes. All 60 scenes are free to play. The Stagehand Kit and the Spotlight are optional.

**Does it need the internet?**
No. Propworm plays fully offline.

**I reinstalled the game. How do I get the Spotlight back?**
Open Settings and tap Restore Purchases, signed in with the same App Store account.

**Which devices?**
iPhone, from the App Store. It is not out yet; email me at lamnv260398@gmail.com and I will tell you when it is.

**Does it collect data?**
No. Nothing leaves your device except purchases, which go through the App Store. See the privacy policy.

## Support — https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/propworm-site/support.html

### Contact

Write to lamnv260398@gmail.com. Please say which device you play on and, if it is about a scene, its number.

### How to play

Tap a free wing nut and it flies to the open tin of its colour; each tin holds three. With no matching tin open, the nut waits on the bench, and a full bench ends the scene. Every tap, the woodworm takes one step along its numbered marks: it knocks out a free nut it lands on, or bores a hole in the top flat. A flat falls when its last nut is out. The game also has a How to play page in Settings and in the Pause menu.

### Purchases

All 60 scenes are free. The Stagehand Kit adds five of each tool and can be bought again; the Spotlight is a one-time unlock. Bought something before, or on another device with the same store account? Open Settings → Restore Purchases.

### Progress

Progress is saved on the device only. It is not synced between devices, and it is removed if you delete the app.

---

## Privacy Policy — https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/propworm-site/privacy.html

Propworm · last updated 12 November 2026

Propworm is a puzzle game. It does not ask who you are, and it does not sell any data about you.

### What stays on your device

- Your progress: the highest scene you have cleared and how many Top Hats, Spanners and Intermissions you have.
- Your settings: whether sound is on.
- Whether you have bought the Spotlight, and the store's transaction ids for purchases already delivered, so a purchase is never granted twice.

This is stored on your device only. Deleting the app removes it.

### What we do not do

- No account or sign-in.
- No advertising and no ad networks.
- No analytics, crash reporting or tracking of any kind.
- No access to your contacts, photos, location, camera or microphone.

### Purchases

All 60 scenes are free. The Stagehand Kit and the Spotlight are optional purchases, handled entirely by the App Store under its own privacy policy. We receive no payment details; the game only learns from the store which purchases exist.

### Children

The game collects no personal information from anyone, including children.

### Changes

If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date.
